def _noise(seq, c, size=33, total=1000):
    """Create mature sequences around start/end"""
    if len(seq) < size:
        return seq
    start = random.randint(0, len(seq) - size)
    end = start + size
    return seq[:start] + c * (total - len(seq)) + seq[end:]
